Associate Director, HKA
details: Junseok (Junna) Kim is a doctoral researcher at Yonsei University’s Smart Infrastructure Lab. He currently works as an Associate Director in the Construction, Claims & Expert Services practice at HKA’s Seoul office. Previously, he served as Principal Consultant (Delay Lead) at Kim & Chang Law Firm and as Senior Consultant at FTI Consulting. His professional work focuses on extension-of-time (EOT) claims and technical support for construction disputes and international arbitration.

His research examines how contemporaneous records and supporting evidence shape the review and closure of time and cost claims in international construction projects. Focusing on claim governance and entitlement conversion, he investigates what claim determinations and settlements actually resolve—and what they leave open—with respect to claimed extensions of time and monetary amounts.

- Claim governance and entitlement conversion in international construction — what time and cost claims settle, and what they leave open
- Evidence-based claim decisions in international construction

- Professional Engineer in Soil Mechanics and Foundation Engineering, South Korea
- Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng), Australia

- Member of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators (MCIArb), United Kingdom

details: Baul (Paul) Lee is a doctoral researcher at Yonsei University’s Smart Infrastructure Lab. He began his career at the Korea Rural Community Corporation as a Project Manager, working on the development and maintenance of water infrastructure projects. He then joined the Korea Research Institute for Construction Policy, where he conducted research on smart technology applications, construction policy, and specialized contractor policies. Later, he served as a Consultant and Researcher at Savills (Seoul office), focusing on real estate development consulting and market research. Currently, he works at Shinyoung Securities, specializing in real estate development and investment for Family Office and High Net Worth individuals.

- Construction industry policy
- Applications of smart technology to construction sites and industries
- Economic feasibility analysis of development projects
